steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json configuration describing package name com.minitoolbox.app and app name Mini Toolbox.

steps.title: Setup Build Dependencies
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle targeting SDK version 34 and Java 8 compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish the application manifest structure containing relative namespace configuration and native Material Light Theme launcher definition.

steps.title: Create Card Background Drawable
steps.description: Write custom rounded background drawable with precise subtle borders for the main tool buttons on the dashboard.

steps.title: Create Button Background Drawable
steps.description: Establish styling rules for uniform rectangular indigo action buttons with curved corners.

steps.title: Create Result Box Background
steps.description: Formulate a third drawable file to design clean result boxes and dice frames with light gray interior layers.

steps.title: Design Dashboard and Tools UI Layout
steps.description: Create the rich single-screen multi-view structure of activity_main.xml consisting of Tip Calculator, Unit Converter, Dice Roller, and Stopwatch widgets.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Initialization
steps.description: Create MainActivity, load widgets, register UI screen containers and program smooth transition switcher mechanics.

steps.title: Implement Calculator and Converter Logic
steps.description: Integrate math calculations in Java 8 syntax for tip ratios and metric/imperial unit conversions.

steps.title: Implement Stopwatch and Dice Roller Engines
steps.description: Add multi-character dynamic ASCII unicode dice values, rollover memory, and high-precision stopwatch handler thread loops.

steps.title: Building Mini Toolbox
steps.description: Run strict gradle test commands to compile and verify all assets to assemble the project build without any external dependencies.
